events.title: NVIDIA releases Kumo Tabular for zero-training table prediction
events.title_zh: NVIDIA 发布免训练表格预测模型 Kumo Tabular
events.summary: NVIDIA released Kumo Tabular, an open-weight tabular foundation model that predicts classification or regression targets from labeled rows in one forward pass without task-specific training or feature engineering. Three models span 28M to 215M parameters and were pretrained entirely on synthetic tables. NVIDIA reports first-place aggregate results on TabArena, BeyondArena, TALENT and ScoringBench. The weights are ungated under OpenMDW-1.1 and inference code is Apache-2.0, but the training recipe and synthetic-data generator are promised rather than available.
events.why_it_matters: For teams maintaining many small gradient-boosted models, Kumo Tabular is a credible candidate for cold-start and low-label baselines. Trial the Medium model on held-out tables and calibration, then compare end-to-end latency and GPU cost with tuned tree ensembles. Do not treat the four leaderboard wins as independent confirmation: they are vendor-run, and performance can degrade outside the training ranges or under context/query distribution shift.
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 发布开放权重表格基础模型 Kumo Tabular。它把带标签的行当作上下文，用一次前向计算完成分类或回归，无需针对任务训练或做特征工程。三种模型规模从 28M 到 215M 参数，全部用合成表格预训练。NVIDIA 报告它在 TabArena、BeyondArena、TALENT 与 ScoringBench 的综合排名均为第一。权重免申请并使用 OpenMDW-1.1，推理代码为 Apache-2.0；训练配方与合成数据生成器则仍停留在“即将发布”。
events.summary_en: NVIDIA released Kumo Tabular, an open-weight tabular foundation model that predicts classification or regression targets from labeled rows in one forward pass without task-specific training or feature engineering. Three models span 28M to 215M parameters and were pretrained entirely on synthetic tables. NVIDIA reports first-place aggregate results on TabArena, BeyondArena, TALENT and ScoringBench. The weights are ungated under OpenMDW-1.1 and inference code is Apache-2.0, but the training recipe and synthetic-data generator are promised rather than available.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对维护大量小型梯度提升树模型的团队来说，Kumo Tabular 值得作为冷启动和少标签基线。可以先用 Medium 版本在留出表格上验证准确率与校准，再把端到端延迟和 GPU 成本与调优后的树模型比较。不要把四个 leaderboard 第一当成独立验证：这些都是厂商运行，超出训练范围或 context/query 分布变化时性能可能下降。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams maintaining many small gradient-boosted models, Kumo Tabular is a credible candidate for cold-start and low-label baselines. Trial the Medium model on held-out tables and calibration, then compare end-to-end latency and GPU cost with tuned tree ensembles. Do not treat the four leaderboard wins as independent confirmation: they are vendor-run, and performance can degrade outside the training ranges or under context/query distribution shift.

technical_details.sizes: 28M to 215M parameters; Small, Medium and Large
technical_details.tasks: classification and regression from labeled context rows
technical_details.training: synthetic Structural Causal Model tables only; about 35M/71M/137M tables
technical_details.context_scale: training stages extend to 60,000 rows and 100 columns
technical_details.vendor_benchmarks: ranked first overall on TabArena, BeyondArena, TALENT and ScoringBench
technical_details.availability: ungated weights plus GPU-native structured-data-models library
technical_details.limits: numerical/categorical inputs; up to 10 classes per forward pass before error-correcting extension; shift and out-of-range tables can degrade accuracy; training recipe/data generator not yet released

technical_details_zh.任务: 根据带标签 context 行执行分类与回归
technical_details_zh.训练: 只用 Structural Causal Model 合成表格；约 35M/71M/137M 张表
technical_details_zh.context 规模: 训练阶段扩展到 60,000 行、100 列
technical_details_zh.可用性: 免申请权重，加 GPU 原生 structured-data-models 库
technical_details_zh.限制: 输入限数值/类别列；单次前向最多 10 类，更多类别靠纠错编码扩展；分布变化或超出训练范围会降准；训练配方和数据生成器尚未发布
